get.description:
Returns per-pool **swap volume** and **fees** in USD for 1d, 7d, and 30d windows for
classic (XYK / Stableswap) pools.

Data is rolled up from **dex-totals** ``pool_daily`` (built by ``compute_non_dlmm_totals.py``
from Stacks ``contract_logs``, cached in Redis). This matches global classic metrics on
``/analytics/dex-totals``. Swap volume only (not add/withdraw).

**Note:** After deploying ``pool_daily`` support, run a **full** non-DLMM totals cron/backfill
once so Redis contains per-pool daily history; incremental runs then maintain it.

**Query:** `contracts` — comma-separated `pool_contract` values (max 200).

**Cache TTL:** 60 seconds.

get.description:
Get bin information for a specific user and pool

**Real-time Updates:**
- Default: 5-second cache for optimal performance
- Use `fresh=true` to bypass cache and get immediate data

**Fallback Behavior:**
- Default: `X-Allow-Fallback` is enabled (no header needed)
- `X-Allow-Fallback: false`: disables on-chain fallback (returns only DB/cached data)

**Cache TTL:** 5 seconds (use `fresh=true` to bypass)

**Response Headers:**
- `X-Cache-Status`: HIT, MISS, or BYPASS
- `X-Cache-TTL`: Cache TTL in seconds (5)
- `X-Data-Fallback-Applied`: true/false - indicates if on-chain fallback was used
- `X-Data-Age-Seconds`: seconds since the most recently updated bin (staleness indicator)

**Response body `meta` (when present):** `dataSource`, `maxBinBlockHeight`, `minBinBlockHeight`,
`unprocessedLiquidityEventCount` (DLMM liquidity pipeline backlog for the pool), `binRowCount`.
Use with `bins[].blockHeight` for PnL anchoring (see core-adapter `docs/BIN_FRESHNESS_AND_REPROCESS_RUNBOOK.md`).

schema.title: Response Get Dex Metrics Api App V1 Analytics Dex Metrics Get

get.description:
Returns aggregate metrics across three pool categories:
- **DLMM**: From adapter DB (dex_metrics_summary), updated by core-adapter workers.
- **Classic** (XYK/Stableswap): From contract_logs + Bitflow, stored in cache via cron.
- **Legacy**: Static historical totals from retired contracts, baked into the service.

**Combined totals** roll all three categories together. Each metric is also broken out by source:
- **totalSwapVolumeUsd** / Dlmm / Classic / Legacy: All-time swap volume USD.
- **totalTvlUsd** / Dlmm / Classic: Current TVL (Legacy pools have no active TVL).
- **totalTransactions** / Dlmm / Classic / Legacy: Swap + add + withdraw event count.
- **totalTransactionVolume** / Dlmm / Classic / Legacy: Sum of swap + add + withdraw volume USD.
- **totalFeesUsd** / Dlmm / Classic / Legacy: All-time total fees USD.
- **totalFeesProtocolUsd** / Dlmm / Classic: Protocol fee breakdown by source.
- **totalFeesProviderUsd** / Dlmm / Classic: Provider (LP) fee breakdown by source.
- **uniqueUsersClassic** / **uniqueUsersLegacy**: Unique callers per category.
- **legacy\***: Detailed Legacy breakdown (swap/add/withdraw volume + event counts).
- **poolBreakdown**: Per-pool stats for Classic pools.
- **dailyBreakdown**: Per-day aggregated volumes/counts/fees for Classic pools.
- **tokenVolumes**: Per-token volumes in USD for Classic pools.

Get bin-level metrics for a specific pool

**Cache TTL:** 60 seconds (1 minute)

get.description:
Get user earnings history (daily aggregated data)

Returns daily earnings per bin including both USD and native token amounts.

**Response includes:**
- `earnings[].userEarningsUsd` - earnings in USD
- `earnings[].userEarningsXToken` - earnings in token X (normalized, human-readable units)
- `earnings[].userEarningsYToken` - earnings in token Y (normalized, human-readable units)
- `earnings[].totalFeesXToken` - total pool fees in token X for the period
- `earnings[].totalFeesYToken` - total pool fees in token Y for the period
- `poolTokens` - token metadata (symbol, name, decimals, contractAddress) keyed by pool ID

**Cache TTL:** 10 seconds (historical data)

get.description:
Get tickers data for CoinGecko listing (DEX format)

Returns 24-hour pricing and volume information on each market pair available on the exchange.

**Cache TTL:** 60 seconds (1 minute)

**Response Format (DEX):**
- ticker_id: base_currency_target_currency (contract addresses)
- base_currency: contract address of base token
- target_currency: contract address of target token
- last_price: last transacted price (JSON number)
- base_volume: 24-hour trading volume in base currency (JSON number)
- target_volume: 24-hour trading volume in target currency (JSON number)
- pool_id: pool/pair address or unique ID (mandatory for DEX)
- liquidity_in_usd: pool liquidity in USD (mandatory for DEX, JSON number)
- bid: current highest bid price (recommended, JSON number)
- ask: current lowest ask price (recommended, JSON number)
- high: rolling 24-hours highest transaction price (recommended, JSON number)
- low: rolling 24-hours lowest transaction price (recommended, JSON number)

get.description:
Check if BFF API data is in sync with on-chain state.

This endpoint queries the Core Validation Service to determine if the cached/indexed
data is stale or out of sync with the blockchain.

**Response Fields:**
- `status`: Overall health status (`healthy`, `unhealthy`, `error`, `unconfigured`)
- `isHealthy`: Boolean indicating if all data is in sync
- `lastValidation`: Timestamp of the last validation run
- `lastOverall`: Result of last validation (`pass` or `fail`)
- `isRunning`: Whether a validation is currently in progress
- `isRetrying`: Whether a retry is in progress after a failure
- `validationCount`: Total number of validations performed
- `failedPoolIds`: List of pool IDs that failed validation
- `failedPoolCount`: Number of pools that failed validation
- `poolSyncStatus`: Per-pool sync status with details on:
  - `poolData`: Pool metadata sync status (`pass`, `fail`, `error`, `skipped`)
  - `poolBins`: Bin data sync status
  - `userBins`: User position bins sync status
- `poolCount`: Total number of pools being monitored
- `serviceAvailable`: Whether the Core Validation Service is reachable

**Use Cases:**
- Frontend can display a warning banner when data might be stale
- Automated monitoring and alerting on data sync issues
- Debugging data inconsistencies between on-chain and indexed data

get.description: Root endpoint

Health check endpoint.

Returns 503 only when critical deps (primary DB, Redis) are down.
Individual multi-DB backend failures return 200 with "degraded" status
since the BFF can still serve from the remaining backends.
Lightweight liveness probe — confirms the process is running.
Lightweight readiness probe — Redis only (avoids heavy multi-DB /health on every probe).
